about.title: About ApolloBot
about.description: Replaces supported social links with embed-friendly providers and reposts them through a webhook relay.
about.platforms: Twitter/X, Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, Kick, Bluesky, Threads (experimental)
about.features:
• Provider cycling buttons
• Original poster-only controls
• Delete button
• Cooldowns
• Persistence
• User ignore system
• User/server stats and achievements
• Random fox, cat, and dog commands
• Reply ping for original poster
• Server enable/disable and whitelist settings
• Slash roll command
• Public vote command
• Public planned updates list
• Support command for bug reports and feedback
• Dynamic provider management for bot owners
